neighbours.label: Attaching a label, tag or mark to an item: label/tag/mark/stamp/designate X with Y, annotate, barcode, assign a class to X
fire: Volunteers tagged every photo with the place where it was taken.
The warehouse stamps each crate with a serial number before shipping.
Delegates wore badges marked with their country and role.
She colour-coded the folders by year, red for 2019 and blue for 2020.
The surveyor annotated the map with symbols for each well.
Before the move, we numbered the boxes and listed their contents on the lid.
All blood samples are barcoded with the patient's identifier.
The trail is marked with yellow blazes painted on the trees.
quiet: Volunteers sorted every photo by the year it was taken.
The warehouse wraps each crate with plastic film before shipping.
Delegates sat with their country's representatives at lunch.
She stored the folders by year in the cabinet downstairs.
The surveyor crossed the field with a tripod and a notebook.
Before the move, we packed the boxes and carried them to the van.
All blood samples are chilled with ice during transport.
The trail is lined with yellow flowers in early spring.
